items.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
items.summary: Donald Trump has blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect, as a row with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky deepens The sanctions were passed by the US Congress and signed into law by Trump in September But the US president issued an executive order on Friday night saying that suspending some was in the US "national interest", prompting a backlash from US lawmakers. Zelensky said it was unfortunate the US has decided to "completely disregard" the sanctions Relations between Washington and Kyiv frayed after the US struck a controversial deal to import Russian diesel . Ukraine then accused the Trump administration of withdrawing key military support Trump and Zelensky have exchanged sharp words about one another.

items.title: Mozambique: ANE awards 20.6 billion meticais for Inhambane and Sofala road contracts
items.summary: According to the contract award notices published by ANE’s provincial delegations, the contracts concern new lots for road engineering and paving projects, five of which are located in Inhambane province, in southern Mozambique, and four in Sofala, in the centre of the country The awards fall under the 2026–2031 Accelerated National Road Rehabilitation and Construction Programme, known as “More Roads – 2031”, and cover national and regional road links In Inhambane province, the contracts total 285 kilometres and 10,104,807,009 meticais (€143.6 million) The contracts were awarded to a consortium comprising the companies Maripoma Entreprise Limitada, from Mozambique, Maripoma Entreprise Limitada, from Ghana, CC Building Limitada and GWIC Moçambique Limitada The largest lot in Inhambane covers the 70-kilometre Sitila–Funhalouro section of road R444, awarded for 2,469,027,132 meticais (€35 million) On the same road corridor, the 40-kilometre Massinga–Sitila section was awarded for 1,612,980,998 meticais (€22.9 million) On national road N222, the 58-kilometre Mapinhane–Macumene section…

items.title: Mozambique: Grain Institute explores cooperation opportunities at Trade Expo Indonesia
items.summary: The Mozambique Grain Institute (ICM), represented by its Director-General, Luís Jobe Fazenda, is participating in the 41st edition of Trade Expo Indonesia (TEI), the largest trade and investment platform in Southeast Asia, taking place from 14 to 18 October at the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE), in Greater Jakarta Photo: Instituto de Cereais de Moçambique, IP The ICM is part of the official delegation of the Ministry of Economy, headed by the Secretary of State for Trade, António Grispos As a central player in the agricultural marketing value chain, the ICM is taking part in this global forum to develop cooperation opportunities covering everything from strategic supply to the final marketing of products.

items.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
items.summary: Brazil's government says deforestation rates in the country's Amazon and savanna regions have fallen to record lows ahead of a presidential election run-off in which the rainforest's future is a key issue Left-wing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, when he assumed office three years ago, pledged to end deforestation by 2030 in the Amazon. It had surged under his right-wing predecessor, Jair Bolsonaro Lula will face Bolsonaro's son Flavio in the run-off on 25 October, with polls suggesting a neck-and-neck race. Flavio is expected to continue his father's policies if he wins, though he has pledged to fight organised crime in the Amazon Satellite data shows that in the year to July 2026, the deforestation rate fell by 41.8% in the Amazon - the biggest drop since records began in 1988.
